item.title: The Breakfast Club
item.description:
Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 2:15 PM

By midweek, we could all use a little pick-me-up. Wine Wednesdays are your perfect excuse to press pause on your problems and pour a glass instead. Each ticket includes a complimentary glass of house wine—so you can toast being halfway to the weekend with friends (or a very good date). Then sink into our ultra-comfortable seats and enjoy a fan-favorite film under the stars. Midweek meltdown? Best handled with a movie. 🍷🎬

item.title: The Princess Diaries
item.description:
Sunday, August 16, 2026 at 2:15 PM

Mia Thermopolis Mignonette Grimaldi, Princess of Genovia, had a lot to learn about royal life—luckily, you already have the style down. Join us for a special Girls Gone Mild screening of this quintessential classic. Want to level up your look? Add on our Charm Bracelet Package to craft your own custom jewelry before the show. It's the perfect way to channel your inner princess (no painful posture lessons required). Grab your besties and get ready for a night of pure, tiara-worthy nostalgia!
